name: list_meta_injector_reports
description: Lists already captured temporary Meta Injector telemetry reports in volatile server memory, returning product/run/capture identities, pagination, and measured UI-audit availability. Unavailable reports are not successful tests and do not establish absence of errors.

productId.description: Optional Shopify Product GID filter matching gid://shopify/Product/<digits>.

mode.description: Optional nonempty capture mode filter (up to 120 characters).

limit.description: Optional maximum number of report metadata entries to return (integer 1-5, default 3).

afterReportId.description: Optional pagination cursor (reportId) to return reports after.

ok.description: Whether the list operation completed without a request or server error.

status.description: Response status such as ok, unavailable, invalid_request, invalid_cursor, or error.

name: read_meta_injector_report
description: Reads one lossless UTF-8 server chunk of a specific captured Meta Injector report or its measured UI audit by reportId. Server chunkIndex values are 0-based and distinct from clipboard part numbers. UI-audit data is measured only when recorded; never equate 67 telemetry targets with visible UI rows.

reportId.description: Required identifier of the captured report (e.g., srep_<sha256>).

chunkIndex.description: Optional 0-based server chunk index to read (nonnegative integer, default 0). Distinct from clipboard part numbers.

ok.description: Whether the read operation completed without a request, not_found, or server error.

status.description: Response status such as ok, not_measured, not_found, invalid_request, or error.
